auditMetadata.project: DineFlow - Next-Gen Multi-Tenant Restaurant & Hospitality OS
auditMetadata.auditor: Autonomous Frontend QA Auditor & CSS Auto-Fix Engineer
auditMetadata.framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4

issues.issue: In Stock status badge overlapped adjacent Edit button
issues.rootCause: Column was allocated col-span-1 (8.3% width, ~60px), which was narrower than the 75px badge width, causing it to overflow into the adjacent Quick Actions column
issues.fixDescription: Rebalanced grid columns from 5-2-2-1-2 to 4-2-2-2-2, providing ~130px for the Status column and eliminating overlap entirely

issues.issue: Global search input placeholder was compressed to 'Sea...' at tablet landscape
issues.rootCause: Breadcrumbs, search input, KDS Connected pill, and user profile competed for horizontal space simultaneously at 1024px
issues.fixDescription: Gated KDS Connected badge to hidden xl:flex and set responsive search container max-width to max-w-[180px] lg:max-w-sm xl:max-w-md

issues.issue: Workspace Overview title was truncated to 'Workspac...'
issues.rootCause: Overly restrictive max-w-[100px] on the current title span on small screens
issues.fixDescription: Increased max-width scale to max-w-[160px] sm:max-w-[220px] md:max-w-[260px]

issues.issue: Touch target was 36x36px, below the WCAG 44x44px mobile requirement
issues.rootCause: Padding p-2 on a 20px icon resulted in a 36px bounding box
issues.fixDescription: Added min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center

issues.rootCause: Missing minimum touch target sizing classes for touch viewports

issues.issue: Bell button was 38x38px and unread counter badge slightly occluded icon
issues.rootCause: Fixed sizing without mobile touch target minimums and tight absolute badge positioning
issues.fixDescription: Added min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px] sm:min-w-[36px] and adjusted badge coordinates to top-0.5 right-0.5

issues.issue: Button sizes 'sm', 'default', and 'icon' were under 44px on mobile devices
issues.rootCause: Button variants used fixed h-8 / h-10 across all devices without responsive touch target scaling
issues.fixDescription: Updated buttonVariants size configurations to ensure min-h-[44px] on mobile devices with smooth step-downs to desktop heights

issues.issue: Extra whitespace before comma in greeting: 'Welcome , Laurent 👋'
Checklist step titles prematurely truncated to 'Brand Identity & Workspa...', 'Configure Dine-in Table...'
issues.rootCause: Unnecessary truncate class inside flex item without full-width flex container
issues.fixDescription: Removed truncate and applied leading-snug flex-1 with min-h-[44px] touch target padding

issues.issue: Order card table name displayed as truncated 'D..'
issues.rootCause: w-full truncate on the table name span inside a flex-wrap container caused aggressive ellipsis collapse
issues.fixDescription: Replaced w-full with shrink-0 max-w-full truncate, preserving full table name readability

issues.issue: WABA Settings button and status badges crowded against the page title at tablet landscape
issues.fixDescription: Configured flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center with flex-wrap gap-2 on action containers

issues.rootCause: truncate class on max-w-xl subtitle paragraph
issues.fixDescription: Removed truncate class, allowing clean multiline rendering
